extracted.intended_audience: journalists, media professionals, and public/press seeking Microsoft press materials
extracted.subtask_description: Locate and use Microsoft's official press materials and resources (press releases, press kits, leadership bios, multimedia, topic pages, regional sources, and contacts) for reporting or corporate communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive press content
rubrics_metrics.description: Get all the latest information about Microsoft news and innovation, leadership and recent events, as well as photos, videos and transcripts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide up-to-date announcements, multimedia (photos, videos), and transcripts so journalists have full context and assets for coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top news aggregation
rubrics_metrics.description: Top news — All the latest news, announcements and stories from Microsoft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a central 'Top news' stream aggregating the most important corporate stories and announcements for quick access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official press releases
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publish formal press releases as the authoritative statements on company news and product announcements; ensure they're easy to find and clearly labeled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official corporate blog
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the company blog to provide longer-form commentary, insights, and stories that supplement formal press releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social channel news distribution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribute news and stories through LinkedIn (and other social channels) to reach professional audiences and amplify official messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Leadership — Biographies, photos and speeches of Microsoft executive officers and board members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide up-to-date executive bios, high-resolution photos, and speech transcripts to support reporting on leadership and quotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press kits
rubrics_metrics.description: Press kits — Top news, information, images and other resources about key topics at Microsoft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assemble topic-specific press kits that bundle context, assets, and background material for reporters covering a particular subject.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic pages (AI)
rubrics_metrics.description: AI — Get the latest AI news and learn how technology is transforming the way people live and work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain curated topic pages (e.g., AI) that highlight news, impacts, and illustrative examples to help journalists tell the story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic pages (Datacenters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Datacenters — Microsoft’s global network of datacenters enable critical services, remote work, AI and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide explanatory content and news on infrastructure topics to contextualize technical stories for media and stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic pages (Health and sciences)
rubrics_metrics.description: Health and sciences — Innovations are contributing to groundbreaking research, empowering clinicians and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer subject-matter pages that showcase industry-specific innovations and use cases for reporter reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company facts and background
rubrics_metrics.description: Facts about Microsoft — Facts and information about the company.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain an accessible factsheet or corporate background resource with key statistics and company overview for accurate reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Events listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Events — Information about recent and upcoming company events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List press-relevant events (dates, agendas, media access) so reporters can plan coverage and attendance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image gallery
rubrics_metrics.description: Image gallery — Photos available for media use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Host high-resolution, captioned images (with usage guidelines) to provide visual assets for stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Video — Video content and clips for media use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide downloadable or embeddable video assets and transcripts to support broadcast and online coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional press sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Microsoft Source / Microsoft Source LATAM / Microsoft Source EMEA / Microsoft Source Asia — regional press portals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer region-specific press hubs to surface locally relevant news, language-appropriate materials, and regional contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Press Contacts — Contact information for media relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publish clear press contact details (names, phone, email, regional/practice areas) so journalists can request interviews or assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regular press newsletters
rubrics_metrics.description: The Monthly Tech-In — a recurring media/resource publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribute periodic newsletters or briefings to keep media and stakeholders informed of ongoing news and trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor relations linkage
rubrics_metrics.description: Investor relations — Links to investor-facing information and announcements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include investor relations materials and financial announcements separately to support coverage of corporate performance and governance.
